title: How a Financial Services Company Modernized Tax with Vertex
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
## The Challenge: Managing Complex Sales Tax Compliance Across Thousands of Jurisdictions


For a global financial services reporting company, managing indirect tax compliance across the U.S., Canada, and the UK meant navigating more than 12,000 taxing jurisdictions,[filing over 200 monthly returns](https://www.vertexinc.com/solutions/products/vertex-indirect-tax-returns-north-america) , and supporting 10 legal entities. Legacy systems and manual processes made reconciliations time-consuming, increased complexity, and created challenges as the business continued to grow through acquisitions.


## The Solution: Modernizing Tax Operations with Vertex O Series On-Demand


To modernize its tax operations, the company migrated to[Vertex O Series On-Demand](https://www.vertexinc.com/solutions/products/vertex-indirect-tax-o-series) and integrated it with Oracle, Salesforce Billing, and Stripe.[By consolidating tax processes into a cloud-based environment](https://www.vertexinc.com/solutions/products/vertex-indirect-tax-o-series) , the organization streamlined tax determination, reduced manual effort, improved reporting visibility, and created a scalable foundation to support new entities, products, and selling channels.


## The Results: $250,000 in First-Year Savings and Improved Audit Readiness


The move to Vertex delivered approximately $250,000 in first-year savings while reducing maintenance costs and automating critical tax workflows. The company improved compliance, strengthened audit readiness, and accelerated onboarding during mergers and acquisitions, helping the tax team support continued business growth with greater confidence and efficiency.

**Industry:** Financial services
**Business Model:** B2B and B2C
**Revenue:** $2.2 billion
